dedication: Built with the TFS Visual Novel Tools engine.

chapters.title: The Locked Room
chapters.pov_desc: A visitor with questions and no easy answers.
intro: This is the demo campaign — two rooms, one guide, one key.
It exists to prove the loop runs: title, chapter select, explore, dialog, inventory, save. Swap in your own data/ and assets/ to make it yours.
outro: You took the key. That's the whole loop — rooms, exits, dialog, an item, a completed quest.
Now open data/ and build your own.
